title: The Smile of the Undercroft
author: Dominic Thackeray
blurb: Orsen Blackwood, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
